<template>
  <view class="invite-page">
    <view class="member-card">
      <view class="member-head">
        <image class="member-avatar" src="{{member.avatar}}" mode="aspectFill" />
        <view class="member-copy">
          <text class="member-name">{{member.name}}</text>
          <text class="member-level">{{member.levelName}}</text>
        </view>
        <text class="member-points">{{member.points}} 积分</text>
      </view>

      <view class="invite-progress">
        <view class="progress-head">
          <text>本月已邀请 {{inviteCount}} 人</text>
          <text>目标 {{inviteGoal}} 人</text>
        </view>
        <progress
          percent="{{invitePercent}}"
          stroke-width="8"
          activeColor="#ff7a45"
          backgroundColor="#ffe7d6"
        />
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="campaign-card">
      <image class="campaign-cover" src="{{campaign.cover}}" mode="aspectFill" />
      <view class="campaign-content">
        <text class="campaign-title">{{campaign.title}}</text>
        <text class="campaign-summary">{{campaign.summary}}</text>
        <view class="reward-row">
          <view class="reward-item" wx:for="{{campaign.rewards}}" wx:key="step">
            <text class="reward-step">邀请 {{item.step}} 人</text>
            <text class="reward-value">{{item.reward}}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="invite-code-card">
      <text class="invite-code-title">我的邀请码</text>
      <text class="invite-code">{{member.inviteCode}}</text>
      <text class="invite-code-tip">好友注册时填写，双方都可获得奖励</text>
    </view>

    <view class="action-row">
      <button class="share-button share-button-wx" open-type="share">分享给好友</button>
      <button class="share-button share-button-web" bindtap@web="shareOnWeb">分享邀请活动</button>
      <button class="detail-button" bindtap="openCampaignDetail">查看活动规则</button>
    </view>

    <view class="invite-list">
      <view class="list-head">
        <text class="list-title">最近邀请</text>
        <text class="list-count">{{invitees.length}} 人</text>
      </view>
      <view class="invitee-row" wx:for="{{invitees}}" wx:key="id">
        <image class="invitee-avatar" src="{{item.avatar}}" mode="aspectFill" />
        <view class="invitee-copy">
          <text class="invitee-name">{{item.name}}</text>
          <text class="invitee-time">{{item.joinedAt}}</text>
        </view>
        <text class="invitee-status">{{item.statusText}}</text>
      </view>
      <view wx:if="{{!invitees.length}}" class="invite-empty">
        <text>分享活动，邀请第一位好友吧</text>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    member: {
      id: 'member-10086',
      name: '林小满',
      avatar: '/assets/member/avatar.png',
      levelName: '黄金会员',
      points: 2860,
      inviteCode: 'MPX2026'
    },
    campaign: {
      id: 'campaign-summer',
      title: '邻里邀请季',
      summary: '邀请好友加入社区商城，最高可得 100 元无门槛券。',
      cover: '/assets/member/invite-cover.png',
      rewards: [
        { step: 1, reward: '10 元券' },
        { step: 3, reward: '30 元券' },
        { step: 5, reward: '100 元券' }
      ]
    },
    inviteCount: 2,
    inviteGoal: 5,
    invitees: [
      {
        id: 'user-1',
        name: '陈晓雨',
        avatar: '/assets/member/friend-a.png',
        joinedAt: '08-10 14:20',
        statusText: '已完成首单'
      },
      {
        id: 'user-2',
        name: '周远',
        avatar: '/assets/member/friend-b.png',
        joinedAt: '08-11 09:16',
        statusText: '已注册'
      }
    ]
  },
  computed: {
    invitePercent () {
      return Math.min(100, Math.round(this.inviteCount / this.inviteGoal * 100))
    }
  },
  onLoad () {
    wx.showShareMenu({ withShareTicket: true })
    this.fetchInviteSummary()
  },
  onShareAppMessage () {
    return {
      title: `${this.member.name} 邀你加入邻里商城`,
      path: `/pages/member/landing?campaignId=${this.campaign.id}&inviter=${this.member.id}`,
      imageUrl: this.campaign.cover
    }
  },
  onShareTimeline () {
    return {
      title: this.campaign.title,
      query: `campaignId=${this.campaign.id}&inviter=${this.member.id}`,
      imageUrl: this.campaign.cover
    }
  },
  methods: {
    fetchInviteSummary () {
      wx.request({
        url: `/api/member/${this.member.id}/invites`,
        success: ({ data }) => {
          this.inviteCount = data.count
          this.invitees = data.list
        }
      })
    },
    shareOnWeb () {
      wx.showToast({ title: '请使用浏览器分享', icon: 'none' })
    },
    openCampaignDetail () {
      wx.navigateTo({
        url: `/pages/member/campaign-detail?id=${this.campaign.id}`
      })
    }
  }
})
</script>
